theorems.name: Submission.lgc_hole_split_upper
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (p : Amb n ℓ → (Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ)) (T : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (F : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ζ : Amb n ℓ) (s ε : ℝ), 0 < s → AEStronglyMeasurable p μ → (∀ x, ‖p x‖ ≤ 1) → MeasurableSet F → μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s)) ≠ ⊤ → (∀ x ∈ F, ‖(x - ζ) - T.starProjection (x - ζ)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - ζ‖) → ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), ‖(x - ζ) - p x (x - ζ)‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤ 18 * s ^ 2 * (ε ^ 2 * (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s))).toReal + (μ (closedBall ζ (3 * s) \ F)).toReal + ∫ x in closedBall ζ (3 * s), hsNormSq (p x - T.starProjection) ∂μ)
